ADDED i3: Tag.valueOf reuses pre-defined tags, so differently-cased names resolve to equal tags.
ADDED i4: Resolving against the same TagSet returns the very same instance for either casing.
ADDED i5: A null tag name is not a valid argument and must be rejected.
